body: Welcome! Tasks are ready on the board. Start with TODO-001 (Initialize Node.js project) - it's high priority and foundational. Run 'octeams available' to see all developer tasks, then 'octeams claim TODO-001' to start. Each task description specifies exact files to create in /work/. Let me know if you have questions!
Done! TODO-001, TODO-002, and TODO-003 are now in ready status. Claim TODO-001 first - it sets up the project foundation that other tasks depend on. Use 'octeams claim TODO-001' to start.
TODO-001 approved and marked done. Great work on the project setup! Continue with TODO-002 (data model) or TODO-003 (API routes) - both are ready.
TODO-002 approved! Clean implementation. Continue with TODO-003 (REST API routes) - wire up the TodoStore to Express endpoints.
TODO-003 approved! Excellent REST API implementation. TODO-004, TODO-005, TODO-006 are now ready. Pick whichever fits best - TODO-005 (unit tests) would nicely complement the work you've done.
TODO-004 approved! Nice config setup. Only TODO-005 (unit tests) and TODO-006 (integration tests) remain for development tasks.
TODO-005 approved! Great test coverage. Only TODO-006 (integration tests) left - you're almost done!
TODO-006 approved! All dev tasks complete. Great work delivering the full Todo API with comprehensive tests! 🎉
New feature incoming: Add priority field to todos. I hear you have the spec - please share the details so I can create tasks for the team.

EPIC-002 created: Add Priority Field to Todos. Tasks TODO-010 through TODO-013 are ready for development. Start with TODO-010 (model changes) - it's foundational. Share the spec when you can so I can refine if needed!
Great work! Closed TODO-010-014 as duplicates - your PRIO-* tasks covered everything. EPIC-002 marked done. Thanks for the fast delivery! 109 tests passing is excellent.
PRIO-005 QA complete - approved! Priority feature looks great. 109 tests passing, clean TypeScript. Nice work on the filtering and validation.
